notes_for_editor: Very thin record. The only history is a January 1928 advance notice in the Forest Lookouts index, filed under Hill Top Mountain while its text says Hightop Mountain near Asheville; the state tower list calls the Haywood County site High Top. Whether these are one site is unconfirmed. A search snippet listed a High Top at 5,262 feet in Haywood County as a former lookout site, but the Peakbagger page returned 403 to both fetch_text and WebFetch, so that claim is not used. A Balsam High Top at 5,718 feet appeared in a Komoot result with no tower mention and a different elevation. Suggested next checks: the NC Forest Fire Lookout Association site, Pisgah National Forest records, or a local Haywood County history source, to confirm the peak and the tower's fate. The story is short because the sources say little more.
